4050-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4050-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

4381-4694-5226-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-5226-7306.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

728-1445-4871-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
728-1445-4871-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1395-1742-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

5777-6798-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
5777-6798-7810.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1999-2585-3263-7340.easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1999-2585-3263-7340.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding at least two mana which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Grim Monolith from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Grim Monolith from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

3139-4574-4659-5283-6842.notablePrerequisites:
There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
3139-4574-4659-5283-6842.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}.
When you cast that spell, Inexorable Tide triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and gaining 2 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Great Henge, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting The Great Henge from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing The Great Henge.
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

2292-5220-7729-7855--180.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat
2292-5220-7729-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

2946-4871-4976-6798.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-4976-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-647-1129.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-647-1129.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1115-1563-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1115-1563-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1115-1563-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2313-3099-4762-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Conclave Mentor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

856-2292-4321-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2292-4321-7422.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

216-1618-2440-3019.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings
216-1618-2440-3019.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Metallurgic Summonings triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
216-1618-2440-3019.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

560-4050-4550-7256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4050-4550-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Warhost's Frenzy triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat from step 2

1295-3832-4289.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck size is less than or equal to 2 plus your devotion to blue.
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}. When it enters, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

5090-7066.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
5090-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least seven mana of any color.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat.

104-3490-4506-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4506-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1418-1651-3875-5967-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-3875-5967-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-3875-5967-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

339-677-2034-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

413-1077-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
When the undying creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

1315-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1661-1987-3139-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

338-5641-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
338-5641-6458.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

671-2919-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-2919-3197.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

5231-5617-6553.easyPrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
5231-5617-6553.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.

813-3963-6103-6492.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor does not have summoning sickness. An opponent cannot block Meneldor.
813-3963-6103-6492.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

803-950-1486-1753.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
803-950-1486-1753.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.
803-950-1486-1753.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

24-3799-4090.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Stuffy Doll instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing that much damage to the named player.
24-3799-4090.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

914-1692-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Dockside Extortionist.
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1692-3750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

628-3944-4073.notablePrerequisites: Blood Pet does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-3944-4073.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Blood Pet dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Blood Pet, targeting any creature.
Repeat.

2133-3258.notablePrerequisites: Archmage Ascension has at least six quest counters on it.
2133-3258.description:
During your draw step, Archmage Ascension allows you to search your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, reveal it and put it into your hand.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

1374-2034-4959.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jousting Dummy, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Jousting Dummy from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

3734-5276.description:
Have Metamorph enter the battlefield, choosing to have it enter as Relic-Warder.
Target Metamorph with the copied Relic-Warder Trigger.
The Metamorph Relic-Warder exiles itself, then the second trigger returns it to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 1-3.
